name: Physics
tagline: Passionate about how the universe actually works? This one's for you.
description: Explore mechanics, thermodynamics, electromagnetism, and modern physics through challenging theoretical and experimental problems.

district.label: Foundation (NEB Gr. 11–12)
district.honestNote: Nepal has no official district-level physics olympiad. MoEST's 2082 procedure allows 'district or province'; NPS chose province. This slot is the NEB Grade 11–12 syllabus itself — about 90% of NePhO Round-1 marks come from it.

rounds.name: NePhO Round 1 (Pre-selection Test)
rounds.format: 3 h 15 m · 100 marks · 11 questions (5 short + 6 long)
rounds.marking: No deduction for incorrect answers; marks deducted for improper significant figures; every answer starts on a new page; labelled diagram expected
rounds.eligibility: Higher-secondary student; under 20 by 30 June; not enrolled in any Bachelor's programme
rounds.registration: Through your institution or self; deadline ≈ Mangsir (December)
rounds.centres: ≈ 10 provincial centres (Kathmandu, Biratnagar, Birgunj, Janakpur, Bharatpur, Pokhara, Butwal, Nepalgunj, Mahendranagar, Dhangadhi; Palpa in one NPS document)

rounds.name: NePhO Final Round (after mandatory camp)
rounds.registration: Accommodation only is arranged by NPS; insurance is the student's job; under-16s need a minor certificate + parental consent

rounds.name: IPhO
rounds.format: Theory 5 h / 30 marks + Experimental 5 h / 20 marks
rounds.eligibility: Top 5 of the Final Round; valid passport required

contacts.role: Runs NePhO; selects & trains the IPhO team
